correctness.rationale: For each positive D,r and integer N, the radial sufficient statistic is S=UB with U~Exp(1), B~Gamma(N/2,1) independently; the Mellin product yields the displayed exact Bessel-K density and entropy formula. Chain-rule conditional information is strictly positive, as the posterior variance-mixture is nondegenerate. An exact Laplace marginal gives I_1. The first correction is reconstructed from log-Gamma variance, Fisher translation information one for log-Exp, a tail-controlled chi-square/relative-entropy bound and Stirling/digamma expansion; coefficient 2/(3N). The standalone checker passed 78 finite normalization, quadrature, posterior, monotonicity and asymptotic assertions; these are corroboration and not infinite proofs.

originality.rationale: The specific target of comparison is the exact mutual information I(reset age; one complete N-vector stationary snapshot), strict finite-N growth and positive coefficient 2/(3N). The common Poisson age, multivariate stationary Gaussian mixture and Bessel-K law are explicit in Biroli et al. (2022), and scalar conditional backward age is explicit in Masó-Puigdellosas et al. (2022); those premises are not novel. General asymptotic half-log-N information is prior Bayesian asymptotic theory (Clarke and Barron 1990). Neither primary paper computes the hidden-age information correction, and available closely relevant public mathematical summaries concern other hidden environments and observables. Residual broad second-order Bayes-information coverage remains possible and is explicitly not excluded.
residual_risks: General unpublished or uninspected higher-order Bayesian mutual-information asymptotics might already give the same 2/(3N) term in equivalent notation.
A relevant public hidden-environment result was accessible only as a scientific summary; a whole-document absence claim is not made.
The original 2022 stationary joint density implies the underlying product representation, and its implicit consequences could limit independent publication priority.
The small-noise entropy expansion relies on tail-controlled relative-entropy estimates; these are shown analytically but no independent formal verification has occurred.
